description: This file defines API routes for managing communications in a CRM backend, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting communication records using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: _paginate
methods.description: Helper function to paginate query results.

methods.name: list_communications
methods.description: API endpoint to list communications with optional filtering by client ID.

methods.name: create_communication
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new communication linked to a client.

methods.name: get_communication
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a communication by its ID.

methods.name: update_communication
methods.description: API endpoint to update an existing communication.

methods.name: delete_communication
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a communication.
